summary: Large loads must disclose on-site backup generating facilities (non-exporting, able to serve at least 50% of on-site demand); in an energy emergency ERCOT may direct them to deploy backup generation or curtail, without authorizing emissions violations. Transmission-voltage loads interconnected after December 31, 2025 must install equipment allowing curtailment during firm load shed; ERCOT must procure a demand-reduction service from loads of at least 75 MW with 24-hour notice.

source.citation: Texas SB 6 (89th Leg., enrolled; effective June 20, 2025), LegiScan mirror
